## 主张 Claim

沿固定关系规律中的实际有限历史，全部存在性端点可能保留当且仅当存在返回路径。无法返回具有构造性的丧失端点见证；不完整问题集合可以遮蔽此损失。 / Along an actual finite trace under a fixed relational law, all existential endpoint possibilities are preserved exactly when a return path exists. Failure to return has a constructive lost endpoint witness; incomplete questions can hide this loss.

Canonical source: [BecomingReversibility.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/BecomingReversibility.lean)

## 沿革 History

- 2026年10月9日：登记经检查的结构连接及作者反审；辅助声明与重复应用不计作独立基础成果。 / 9 October 2026: checked structural connection and author counterreview registered. Helpers and repeated applications are not counted as independent foundational results.
- 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述为核心定律的实例。核心（Becoming.Recurrence）对每一过程无前提地证明：自 s 可达的每一配置自 t 仍可达，恰当 t 可回到 s（keeps_reach_iff_returns）；沿自 s 至 t 的路径，两者可达的配置相同，恰当此路径可撤回（same_reach_iff_returns）；无回路即失去一可能，s 本身即见证（not_returns_iff_loses）。BecomingReversibility 的可达即核心的可达，一可能即处于某可达配置（keeps_possible_iff_keeps_reach），所以 same_endpoint_possibilities_iff_return 与 irreversible_iff_endpoint_loss 即这些定律（same_endpoint_possibilities_iff_return_by_core、irreversible_iff_endpoint_loss_by_core），公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围；桥接自此导入 BecomingReversibility，脊柱运行将其作为继承模块编译。 / 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine as an instance of core laws. With no premise the core (Becoming.Recurrence) proves, for every process, that every configuration reachable from s stays reachable from t exactly when t leads back to s (keeps_reach_iff_returns), that along a path from s to t the reachable configurations are the same exactly when the path can be undone (same_reach_iff_returns), and that no way back is a lost possibility with s itself as witness (not_returns_iff_loses). BecomingReversibility's reachability is the core's and a possibility is being at some reachable configuration (keeps_possible_iff_keeps_reach), so same_endpoint_possibilities_iff_return and irreversible_iff_endpoint_loss are these laws (same_endpoint_possibilities_iff_return_by_core, irreversible_iff_endpoint_loss_by_core), with empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope; the bridge now imports BecomingReversibility, which the spine run compiles as an inherited module.
